name: branches
description: Branch of a company: a location with its own business time zone, assigned members and, later, devices.
lifecycle: Created ACTIVE; archived rather than deleted so references remain valid.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated immutable branch UUID; public resource ID.
Branch name, unique among the company's active branches regardless of case.
IANA time zone for the branch's local business time.
ACTIVE branches are usable; ARCHIVED branches are retained for references.
Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful change.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change; not audit history.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A branch belongs to an existing company.
Time zone has the IANA identifier shape.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branches_company_active_name_unique ON public.branches USING btree (company_id, lower((name)::text)) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'::"BranchStatus")
constraints.Purpose: Active branch names are unique within a company, ignoring case, including racing creations.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branches_company_id_id_key ON public.branches USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that tenant references target.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX branches_company_status_name_idx ON public.branches USING btree (company_id, status, name)
constraints.Purpose: Supports listing a company's branches by state and name.
